risks.detection: free-space polling, admission caps and per-scenario/archive growth ledger
risks.prevention: use separate single compressed archive, bounded scenario temp and reserve; never assume expansion ratios are true bounds
risks.fail_closed_response: pause incomplete acquisition; request new capacity/budget; never delete history or drop scenarios

risks.detection: total/quoted ETag mismatch, invalid Range, eventual source hash discrepancy
risks.prevention: bind accepted URL/size/ETag, exact prefix hash and identity response contract
risks.fail_closed_response: STOP; record exact mismatch; no substitution/fresh download without separate authorization

risks.prevention: exact compressed offset and identity encoding; verify validator before append
risks.fail_closed_response: STOP and preserve new staging; fresh download requires separate authorization

risks.detection: missing prefix, wrong length or full SHA-256
risks.prevention: full prefix validation before copy/reuse; immutable historical source
risks.fail_closed_response: STOP; no repair, overwrite, redownload or substitute

risks.detection: progress/throughput/resource/failure logs independent of model performance
risks.prevention: bounded chunks, compact clean blocks, durable checkpoints and deterministic replay
risks.fail_closed_response: pause/report resource failure; do not silently accept partial traversal or change target

risks.detection: unchanged accepted finite-optimum/separation audit and per-modality statuses
risks.prevention: FIT/CAL role isolation; unchanged calibration and validity code
risks.fail_closed_response: STOP before GAT; methodology decision; any repair is Experiment 2B

risks.risk: pseudo anomalies not representative of real anomalies
risks.detection: distinguish constructed CAL diagnostics from fresh final evidence; later locked discrepancy reporting
risks.prevention: keep recipe/severity fixed; explicit constructed target semantics; fresh final holdout
risks.fail_closed_response: report limitation/negative results; never retune 2A from final outcomes

risks.detection: TRAIN-only health diagnostics, then locked generalization evidence
risks.prevention: freeze features to isolate breadth; separate breadth/graph/prior conclusions
risks.fail_closed_response: retain negative outcome; new representation experiment 2B, no invisible rescue

risks.detection: score/probability range, exact constants, member disagreement and UQ distributions
risks.prevention: unchanged calibrated score/UQ definitions; no slope cap, severity search or prior amplification
risks.fail_closed_response: apply Gate 2 invalid rule if appropriate; otherwise report saturation/weak-prior limitations unchanged

risks.detection: source role allowlists, old-role hash denylist, access/request counters and audit
risks.prevention: no old detailed TEST results or decoded payloads in development; explicit retrospective label
risks.fail_closed_response: STOP and report leakage; quarantine affected new artifacts; new protocol/authorization needed

risks.detection: complete artifact classification and clean/source projection hashes; parent/role provenance validation
risks.prevention: new partition once; rebuild all pseudo/calibrator/model/graph/checkpoint/threshold/prediction state
risks.fail_closed_response: STOP affected reuse; no automatic role relabel of fitted state or pseudo rows

risks.detection: seed/ID/member manifest intersection and output access audit
risks.prevention: disjoint DEV/FINAL specification/storage; FINAL output embargo until full freeze
risks.fail_closed_response: STOP final access; disclose exposure and invalid freshness; new holdout requires separate protocol

risks.risk: raw pseudo inputs discarded too early
risks.detection: verify archive retention and reproducible member extraction before temporary raw release
risks.prevention: retain independent full archive; partition first, later local raw replay for CAL/FIT pseudo
risks.fail_closed_response: STOP pseudo work; no feature-space substitute or altered recipe; restore only from bound retained TRAIN source

risks.detection: compressed byte count, gzip trailer/EOF and TAR/member completion proof
risks.prevention: full-stream completion gate distinct from per-scenario completion; no partial trailing scenario
risks.fail_closed_response: STOP and mark incomplete; never treat prefix as FULL TRAIN

risks.detection: state/preprocessing/metric/threshold/seed seal comparisons and complete failure ledger
risks.prevention: freeze analysis before final; preserve all paired seeds and negative results
risks.fail_closed_response: report deviation; any scientific change is new numbered experiment
